sentences.text: Sanshuiornis is an extinct bird from the Middle Eocene of southern China that resembles modern storks.
It belongs to the class Aves, the subclass Neornithes, and the superorder Neognathae.
The genus is known from a single holotype — the specimen the species is based on — which includes an articulated complete right leg and foot.
Found in black oil shales near Foshan, it was named by Min Wang and colleagues in 2011 as Sanshuiornis zhangi.
This bird lived between 48.07 and 37.71 million years ago during the Lutetian to Bartonian stages.
